brand_identity.name: IL EST MIDI
brand_identity.ux_philosophy: Minimalist, clean, airy, and high-contrast space layout. Inspired by swile.co. Maximize whitespace (negative space) to ensure readability and a premium feel.

headings.cases: Sentence case or Upper case for main titles

imagery_and_art_direction.style: Flat modern vector illustrations mixed with bright, clean, human-centric photography
imagery_and_art_direction.composition: Centered, uncluttered compositions. Characters should look relaxed, social, and professional.
imagery_and_art_direction.ui_mockup_behavior: Cards must use #FFF6E9 or White (#FFFFFF) backgrounds with #0F3D2E typography to guarantee contrast.

forbidden_actions: Do not use pure black (#000000) for text or backgrounds.
Do not use gradients on backgrounds or buttons.
Do not exceed a 30% density of Deep Forest Green (#0F3D2E) on a single screen page to maintain the airy Swile-like feeling.
Do not apply borders to structural containers; use whitespace or subtle background color shifts (#A6C4A2 at low opacity) for separation.
